meta.notes: Import this workflow into n8n. Prerequisites: 1) Create an HTTP Header Auth credential in n8n named 'Zammad API': Header Name = 'Authorization', Header Value = 'Token token=<your ZAMMAD_API_TOKEN from docker/.env>'. 2) Activate the workflow. 3) In Tactical RMM → Alerts → Alert Templates → set webhook URL to the n8n webhook URL shown after activation. Tickets are created in the 'MSP Support' group — ensure this group exists in Zammad (Admin → Groups).
